main_measure.name: mean unusual 3-bar move in the short direction

statistic.name: t of the mean (per-day summed deviations)

main_measure.threshold: mean > 0 with t >= 2 to confirm; mean < 0 with t <= -2 to reject

supporting_check.name: mean unusual move, larger-|forecast| half minus smaller half

decided_by: The t of the mean unusual move lies between -2 and 2 (or its sign disagrees with the mean). No effect (common/verdicts.md): t in the idea's direction +0.189 (below 1), 414 cases (30 needed).
reading: Situation = 7-day close-to-close return below 0 inside the window (the raw scaled_fall sign where the 7 prior bars are not in the window) on bars whose regime is 'trending' (the profile vetoes give 'chop'), side short; cases are short-side bets of >= 2 forecast points, the first one per 3-bar grid cell from each window's first row; the mean unusual move is the mean over cases and its t is over per-day summed deviations; the median split puts |forecast| above the median in the larger half, the rest in the smaller.

effect_check.why: t in the idea's direction +0.189 (below 1), 414 cases (30 needed)
